title: Power Shift: State Election Wins Open Path for Climate Progress
summary: In the U.S. midterm elections, Democrats won control of governorships and state legislatures across the country. At a time of public outcry over data centers and rising electricity costs, incoming leaders will have a mandate to rein in polluters, constrain utilities, and advance clean energy.

After their sweeping victories in the midterm elections, Democrats will control both houses of Congress, meaning they will be able to shape the budget, conduct vigorous oversight and investigations, and refuse to confirm nominees for judgeships and other high positions — but their power will be limited. Any ambitious new bill to tackle climate change, for example, will face President Trump’s veto pen.
summary_zh: 在美國中期選舉中，民主黨贏得了全國州長和州議會的控制權。在公眾對資料中心和電力成本不斷上漲的強烈抗議之際，即將上任的領導人將有責任控制污染企業、限制公用事業並推動清潔能源發展。
在中期選舉中取得壓倒性勝利後，民主黨將控制國會參眾兩院，這意味著他們將能夠制定預算、進行強有力的監督和調查，並拒絕確認法官和其他高級職位的提名——但他們的權力將受到限制。例如，任何雄心勃勃的應對氣候變遷的新法案都將面臨川普總統的否決權。
